Current promotion

Buen Mes promo: 10% down payment plus another 10% over 15 interest-free months, and the air conditioners are included (installation not included). Valid through November 30, 2026.

Description

Ábita is a 31-unit apartment building in Colonia Maya, one of the most established neighborhoods in north Mérida, close to the city’s main shopping, medical and university hubs.

The building has an elevator, controlled access, a backup generator and a rooftop with a pool and a social terrace with grill. Apartments come with ceramic floors, a fitted kitchen with upper and lower cabinets, granite countertops, a tempered-glass shower panel, electric water heater and an electric cooktop with hood.

There are five layouts, from a 40 m² one-bedroom to a 92 m² two-bedroom with 2.5 bathrooms. Models C and D add a second room that works as a study or guest room. Pre-sale with estimated delivery in June 2028. Estimated HOA fee: about $2,500 MXN per month.

Amenities
